verdict: Refining made the quarter — crack spreads surged, refineries ran at 98% and refining pre-tax profit jumped to $6.0B, lifting total earnings to $5.6B on $50.5B of sales.

kpis.label: Refining pre-tax profit
kpis.note: Realized margin $38.00/bbl, vs a loss a year ago

flow.otherDetail: Other income is other income ($404M) plus a $1M gain on dispositions, minus interest and debt expense ($243M), accretion ($14M) and foreign-currency losses ($11M). Equity is equity earnings of affiliates ($561M, mainly Chevron Phillips Chemical) minus $23M of profit belonging to noncontrolling interests, so net income is the $5,616M attributable to Phillips 66. Operating income here is gross profit minus the listed operating costs, before equity earnings and interest — Phillips 66 reports pre-tax income of $7,108M on that basis.

takeaways.title: Sales jumped on higher prices
takeaways.text: Sales rose to $50.5B from $34.5B a year ago, mainly on higher refined-product, crude and NGL prices.

takeaways.title: Refining margins surged
takeaways.text: Realized refining margin was $38.00 per barrel, up from $12.15 a year ago, and refining swung from a $518M pre-tax loss to a $6,031M profit.

takeaways.title: Cash went to buybacks and debt cuts
takeaways.text: The company returned $2.8B to shareholders in the quarter and cut total debt by $2.0B to $18.5B.

oneTimers: Impairments of $32M on the income statement ($29M flagged as a Refining special item in the earnings release)
footerNote: Segments are third-party sales and other operating revenues by segment from the Form 10-Q segment note; they sum to consolidated sales. Chemicals is an equity-method business (Chevron Phillips Chemical) with no consolidated sales, so it is grouped with Corporate and Other here — its $311M of pre-tax earnings arrive through equity earnings, not sales. The earnings release itself does not contain a full GAAP income statement, so the flow is built from the Form 10-Q consolidated statement of income for the same quarter.
follow100Note: Other income in this breakdown combines the other-income and equity-earnings lines from the flow, so the rows add to the net margin.
